verses.cheikh-ahmed-tidiane-sy-fa-ilayka-c1-v5: fatazawwadat nafsī bikulli badīʿati wabadāʾiʿī tabqā ʿalā l-ʾazmāni
verses.cheikh-ahmed-tidiane-sy-fa-ilayka-c1-v6: waraʾaytu ʾannaka lir-risālati ḥāmilu waʿalimtu ʾannaka baʿdu sirru ʾamāni
verses.cheikh-ahmed-tidiane-sy-fa-ilayka-c1-v7: hadhā niẓāmu fī l-kitābi muqaddasu qad kalla ghayruka ʿanhu bil-ʾityāni

verses.cheikh-ahmed-tidiane-sy-fa-ilayka-c1-v10: fakaʾannamā khtalaṭat birūḥika kullihā ʾāyātuhu faḍlā mina r-raḥmāni
verses.cheikh-ahmed-tidiane-sy-fa-ilayka-c1-v11: wajaʿalta dunyā l-ʿālamīna shaqīqata lil-jannati l-ʿulyā bikulli maʿāni

verses.cheikh-ahmed-tidiane-sy-fa-ilayka-c1-v13: waʾabayta dīna ḍ-ḍuʿfi lā mustakbirā warafaʿta shaʾana d-dīni bil-ʾīmāni

verses.cheikh-ahmed-tidiane-sy-fa-ilayka-c1-v16: mā nuqṭatu t-tawḥīdi qablu biʿʿushihā mā basṭatu l-khaṭṭi l-madīdi th-thānī
verses.cheikh-ahmed-tidiane-sy-fa-ilayka-c1-v17: ṭuwiyat bitawrāti l-kalīmi wawūriyat bimakāmini l-ʾinjīli lir-ruhbāni
verses.cheikh-ahmed-tidiane-sy-fa-ilayka-c1-v18: waʾatā bihā s-sabʿu l-mathānī ʾashumā biḥurūfihā ḥifẓā lisabʿi mathāni

verses.cheikh-ahmed-tidiane-sy-fa-ilayka-c1-v29: wayubajjilūna l-ʾaghniyā lighināhumu wayuḥāribūna ʾaʾimmaha r-riḍwāni
verses.cheikh-ahmed-tidiane-sy-fa-ilayka-c1-v30: hadhā waʾinnī lā ʾukhālifu ʿunṣurā huwa fī l-ʾirādati nashʾahu l-ʾakwāni
verses.cheikh-ahmed-tidiane-sy-fa-ilayka-c1-v31: lā lā walā t-takrīma kuntu muʿāriḍā ḥattā ʾakhūḍa l-yawma fī dhā sh-shāni

verses.cheikh-ahmed-tidiane-sy-fa-ilayka-c1-v38: ʾafnaytu ʾasbāba l-ḥayāti dirāsata wabalawtu kulla wasāʾili l-ʿirfāni
verses.cheikh-ahmed-tidiane-sy-fa-ilayka-c1-v39: waqadi ntahā kullu liḥalli wāḥidi min ʾan ʾuṭālibahu bikulli ʾamānī
